Copper and gold assets are gaining a structural premium as global electrification and central bank buying drive demand, benefiting operators like AMMN with long-life, low-cost mines.

ALKA's 24% surge signals speculative froth, but AMMN's 7% rise reflects solid copper-gold fundamentals. Watch for profit-taking in laggards like BUMI; prioritize AMMN and BRMS for exposure to critical minerals demand and operational leverage.

Corporate PPAs and ESG mandates in Southeast Asia are accelerating renewable capacity additions, favoring integrated developers like TPIA and BRPT with captive demand.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables rally (+3.24%) signals strong domestic momentum, led by ARKO (+18%) and CDIA (+9%), while US laggards (-0.11%) like PLUG (+5.63%) offer selective entry. Watch BREN and BRPT for sustained upside as policy tailwinds and green capex accelerate, but stay cautious on PLUG's volatility.

sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer/FMCG outperformed (+0.81% ID) vs US (-0.43%), with strong gains in AGAR, BEEF, COCO, and others signaling resilient domestic demand. Focus on companies with pricing power and local supply chains to capture structural consumption growth, as global headwinds remain muted.

themes: Indonesia's regulatory clarity under Bappebti is accelerating licensed exchange listings and institutional custody solutions, creating a structural tailwind for compliant tokens like ADA and GRAM.
Global DeFi yield compression is driving capital into high-APR protocols such as ENA and AAVE, which benefit from Indonesia's young, high-risk appetite demographic.
Tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs) via ONDO and STABLE is gaining traction as Indonesian corporates seek on-chain financing alternatives to traditional banking.
sectors.ai: Surge in ONDO (+18.52%) and VVV (+12.05%) signals renewed institutional appetite for real-world asset tokenization and DeFi yield protocols, while ADA (+7.90%) and AAVE (+6.85%) reflect broader altcoin rotation. Indonesia's crypto-friendly regulatory push and growing retail adoption amplify this momentum. Prioritize ONDO and AAVE for near-term exposure, as they lead on liquidity and narrative alignment with global tokenization trends.
